decisions.reason: The connector inventory, assigned signals, and on-board-only BOOT-button policy are already fully represented by the candidate's existing same-message MODIFY.
The listed panel controls and GPIO assignments do not change the selected ESP32-S3 module family, variant, or model.
The source does not mention 5V_EN or alter its established GPIO5 assignment or boost-rail control behavior.
The panel-control GPIO list does not change the addressable LED data GPIO, power source, standby control, or level shifting.
Identifying the GPIOs used by TTP223 inputs does not change the DCDC1 rail voltage, rating, or powered-load role.
The source contains no change to I2C routing, pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, or bus speed.
The control-input GPIO assignments do not alter the standalone USB supply, its activation condition, source selection, or powered rail.
The BOOT-button placement is already owned by the panel-control connector requirement and does not change USB data routing, enumeration, connector selection, or the programming-port role.
The source lists main-board panel controls and does not change the separate sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The source does not alter the charge-status LED method, GPIO13 assignment, external charge-LED connector, or associated components.
Panel controls and their GPIO assignments do not affect battery overcharge, overdischarge, or electrical-protection behavior.
The source does not change the battery NTC terminal, connector, monitoring function, or thermal-protection controller.
